description: This file defines a set of React components for a custom Select UI element, utilizing Radix UI primitives and Lucide icons. It includes components for the select trigger, content, items, labels, separators, and scroll buttons, with styling and behavior encapsulated within each component.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Main component rendering the root of the select element, passing props to Radix UI's Root component.

methods.name: SelectGroup
methods.description: Component for grouping select items, wrapping Radix UI's Group component.

methods.name: SelectValue
methods.description: Component for displaying the selected value, wrapping Radix UI's Value component.

methods.name: SelectTrigger
methods.description: Component for the button that triggers the dropdown, styled with custom classes and icons.

methods.name: SelectContent
methods.description: Component for the dropdown content, including viewport and scroll buttons, with animation and positioning.

methods.name: SelectLabel
methods.description: Component for labeling sections within the select dropdown.

methods.name: SelectItem
methods.description: Component representing an individual selectable item within the dropdown.

methods.name: SelectSeparator
methods.description: Component for visual separation between groups of items.

methods.name: SelectScrollUpButton
methods.description: Button to scroll the dropdown content upward.

methods.name: SelectScrollDownButton
methods.description: Button to scroll the dropdown content downward.
